title: epiphany-plan plan_document schema
description: The typed contract for the artifact epiphany-plan emits and epiphany-executor consumes. emit renders to this schema; plan_verify validates against it; write_plan persists it. Binding is asymmetric: the PLANNER side (plan_verify) validates against this schema, but the EXECUTOR importer (goatcs_harness/epiphany_plan_importer.py) binds via envelope/signature recognition — NOT this schema file — and is deliberately tolerant of two dialects: the schema-variant envelope (plan_meta + execution_order + coverage_verdict) AND the observed-emit triad (build_order + steps + gate_status). It also reads target_profile / harness_forge / schema_version top-level-OR-nested-under-plan_meta. Keep this schema and the importer's recognizer reconciled (INV-12 co-tuning channel); they are two views of 'valid plan', not one shared validator.

source_spec.description: path or reference to the source specification

dual_mode.description: whether the plan can be rendered in both Markdown and JSON

consumers.description: list of downstream skill/executor names that consume this plan

generated_by.description: skill version and mode that generated this plan

baseline.description: prior version/baseline this plan is based on

global_invariants.description: architectural invariants that must hold across all steps

execution_notes.description: notes for operators about execution semantics, dependencies, integration_checks

target_profile.description: additive, default 'generic'; 'harness-forge' when the plan targets a goatcs/epiphany-harness skill (see ~/docs/epiphany/harness-forge-pipeline-integration.md). Absent ⇒ generic; changes nothing for ordinary plans.

harness_forge.description: optional context-pack forwarded to epiphany-executor when target_profile == 'harness-forge'; mirrors the upstream §17 harness_forge_context. Omitted for generic plans.

blocking.description: whether this gate is blocking (halts execution if FAIL)

open_assumptions.description: list of explicit assumptions baked into the coverage decision

structural_verdict.description: plan_verify's gate result; present once the structural gate has run

decision.description: whether the plan structure is valid

checks.description: list of structural checks that were applied

gate_status.description: aggregated plan-level gate status (coverage + structural verdicts mapped to gates)

blocking_defects.description: plan-level defects that block execution (e.g., unmet prerequisites, missing acceptance criteria)

structural_faults.description: plan-level structural issues that prevent valid execution (e.g., circular deps, missing step, undefined obligation)

input_obligations.description: the complete obligation set ingest extracted (requirement/constraint/section ids). emit SHOULD populate this; tools/plan_verify.py reads it to run the BLOCKING requirements->ledger closure check (8c) — i.e. every obligation must appear in requirement_ledger with a non-empty covered_by. Absent => 8c is advisory-only.

covered_by.description: list of step_ids that collectively discharge this obligation

requirement_ledger.description: mapping of requirements to steps that satisfy them

out_of_scope.description: explicit non-goals and exclusions from the plan scope

roots.description: true DAG sources (steps with no dependencies)

leaves.description: true DAG sinks (steps with no dependents)

terminal_milestones.description: semantic release tail; NOT required to equal leaves

graph_notes.description: narrative explanation of the DAG structure and semantic milestones

refinement_back_edges.description: plan-level back-edges for refinement (named dependents to re-verify on spec change)

execution_order.description: a topological sort of steps (implementation-prerequisite ordering; NOT runtime data flow)

build_order.description: ordered list of step_ids for execution (alias for execution_order)

audit_log.description: audit trail of issues found and resolved during plan construction

step_id.description: unique step identifier within the plan

phase.description: phase identifier (A, B, C, etc.) for phased execution

actions.description: list of concrete actions to implement this step

inputs.description: inputs required from prior steps or external sources

edge_class.description: implementation-prerequisite = build X before Y; runtime-data = X's runtime output feeds Y; ordering = must follow, no data passes; concurrency-prerequisite = X must complete before a parallel/fan-out region Y may fire; feedback-input = X's output feeds a feedback/refinement loop Y (additive, generic — not domain-specific)

dependencies.description: list of step dependencies (may be bare strings or typed objects)

status.description: check status (PENDING, PASS, FAIL, DEFECT, ...). A status matching ^DEFECT raises a BLOCKING defect in epiphany-executor's start gate.

oneOf.description: array of checks — each a bare string OR a typed {id, assert, status} object. The typed form lets epiphany-executor's DoD/gate + background ledger-sentinel track per-check status (PENDING->PASS/DEFECT).

integration_checks.description: cross-step assertions validating this step against prior outputs (array of strings, array of typed objects, or a single object)

refinement_back_edges.description: named dependents to re-verify if this step changes

acceptance_criteria.description: testable gate; executor must not mark done until all pass

traces_to.description: requirement IDs this step traces to (used in Markdown output)

traces_requirements.description: requirement IDs this step traces to (alias for traces_to in schema)

steps.description: list of implementation steps comprising the plan. NOTE: the schema is intentionally tolerant (traces_to / traces_requirements are not in `required` so legacy/partial plans validate), but per N-emit.md + the spec OUTPUT CONTRACT every step MUST carry at least one of traces_to / traces_requirements; tools/plan_verify.py enforces this in check 1 (a traceless step FAILs the gate even though it validates against this schema).

wiring_contract.description: OPTIONAL wiring-contract (harness-skill builds only): one row per skill capability — the integration DoD carried verbatim from the spec. Row shape mirrors goatcs_harness/wiring/contract.py (Phase-1 §2). Absent => behaves as today; plan_verify C11 checks the row<->capability-step bijection only when present.
